def is_complete_tree(root):
    if root is None:
        return True
    q = deque()
    q.append(root)
    has_null = False
    while q:
        node = q.popleft()
        if node is None:
            has_null = True
        else:
            if has_null:
                return False
            q.append(node.left)
            q.append(node.right)
    return True
